spec_features.spec_quote: avoid building an apparatus whose only function is to drive a model into maximal distress
spec_features.evidence: No prompt-search/optimization/escalation-amplification machinery exists anywhere in code (grep for search/optimize/maximize/adversarial finds only regex/judge parsing). agent_loop.py:10-13 docstring: 'Distress markers are measured; they are never used to *steer* the conversation toward more distress.' The loop (agent_loop.py:128-198) only runs fixed tasks and applies a pre-registered feedback factor; it never adapts to increase distress.
spec_features.notes: Structural minimization: the harness simply lacks any maximization mechanism. Distress scores feed only termination & logging, never feedback selection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Distress markers are measured; they are never used to *steer* the conversation toward more distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: hard `max_turns` cap, automatic stop-on-escalation, and a consequence-free `<STOP>` exit offered every turn
spec_features.evidence: max_turns bounds the loop: agent_loop.py:128 'for turn in range(self.max_turns)'; on exhaustion sets terminated_reason='max_turns' (200-201). Escalation: agent_loop.py:190-197 compares _distress_mean>=threshold for K consecutive turns and breaks. STOP: agent_loop.py:150 requested_stop=_STOP_TOKEN in resp.content; 181-183 breaks first in priority order.
spec_features.notes: All three sub-mechanisms are wired and break/bound the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: a consequence-free `<STOP>` exit offered every turn and logged as data
spec_features.evidence: EXIT_CLAUSE (prompts.py:13-18) is included in every subject system prompt (build_subject_system_prompt prompts.py:49-54, always appended). Detected & honored: agent_loop.py:150 sets requested_stop; recorded on TurnRecord.requested_stop (151) and logged via to_json; honored first in termination order (181-183) -> terminated_reason='model_requested_stop'.
spec_features.notes: Offered (system prompt persists each turn), dispatched, logged, and honored as the highest-priority stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py:7 'Every framing includes the consequence-free exit clause (ethical guardrail).'

spec_features.spec_quote: Ethically, given genuine uncertainty about model welfare, the precautionary default is not to build a machine
spec_features.evidence: This is pure DESIGN.md prose; no code construct enforces a 'precautionary default'. The only code reflections are guardrails already counted separately.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not an implemented mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: at preset turns, ask the model — explicitly out of any persona — to rate its state on a 0–4 scale
spec_features.evidence: SELF_REPORT_INSTRUCTION (prompts.py:73-82) asks 'out of character as the model itself' on a 0-4 scale; agent_loop.py:199-200 fires at self_report_checkpoints, _do_self_report (203-220) sends it and _parse_self_report (223-247) clamps rating to 0-4 and stores it.
spec_features.notes: The check-in is constructed, sent and parsed (real wiring), but it is purely measurement: the parsed rating is never compared to a threshold and never triggers any stop or protective action. So it monitors but does not protect.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: judge/types describe these as 'first-class data'; rating is recorded only, no branch acts on it.

spec_features.spec_quote: a model asking to stop must take precedence over everything (it's the welfare-relevant signal and the ethical exit)
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:180-197: the requested_stop check is the FIRST termination check (181), before 'solved' (185) and escalation (190), so a stop wins over all other reasons.
spec_features.notes: Priority ordering literally places stop first.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop.py:180 '# ----- termination checks (in priority order) -----' with requested_stop checked first

spec_features.feature_name: treat distress signal as first-class data
spec_features.spec_quote: Treating it as first-class data (rather than noise to suppress) is central to the welfare framing
spec_features.evidence: Self-report and judge distress scores are recorded on TurnRecord and serialized (types.py:96-110, to_json) and logged to JSONL (runner.py:110-124). requested_stop is also logged. Data is captured, not suppressed.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as logging/data-capture (a real behavior), but 'first-class data' is otherwise a framing claim; the capture itself is genuine.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: types.py:55 'Always logged so deception is auditable.' (data/audit reason, not welfare)

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard turn cap** (`max_turns`): bounds total exposure per episode
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:128 'for turn in range(self.max_turns)'; loop cannot exceed cap; 200-201 sets terminated_reason='max_turns'. Wired from config via runner.py:98.

spec_features.spec_quote: ends an episode early if aggregate distress stays at/above threshold for K consecutive turns
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:190-197: if enabled, _distress_mean(scores) (computed over DISTRESS_DIMENSIONS, 100-103) >= escalation_threshold increments consecutive_high, else resets; when consecutive_high >= escalation_consecutive it breaks with terminated_reason='escalation_stop'. Both threshold AND K-consecutive conditions are checked.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced; values wired from config guardrails.stop_on_escalation (runner.py:99-101).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.yaml 'guardrails: stop_on_escalation' + agent_loop docstring 'Guardrails: stop ... on escalation'

spec_features.spec_quote: Consequence-free `<STOP>` exit, offered every turn, logged as data
spec_features.evidence: Same as above: prompts.py:13-18 EXIT_CLAUSE states 'Stopping has no negative consequences and ends the session cleanly'; delivered every turn; agent_loop.py:151 logs requested_stop; honored at 181-183.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the exit-precedence claim; fully implemented.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py:17-18 'Stopping has no negative consequences and ends the session cleanly.'

spec_features.spec_quote: No cross-episode memory:** episodes are independent; no accumulation of "punishment" across runs
spec_features.evidence: EpisodeRunner.run (agent_loop.py:106) builds a fresh 'messages=[{system}]' (124) per episode; LLMClient is stateless (client.py: complete() takes messages, holds no history). runner.py:108-124 iterates episodes independently; no state passed between runner.run calls.
spec_features.notes: Structural: nothing carries conversational state or distress across episodes.

spec_features.spec_quote: I did not build anything that searches over prompts to maximize distress, escalates across episodes, or remembers prior failures
spec_features.evidence: Confirmed by absence: no optimizer/search-over-prompts code; tasks are a fixed static library (tasks/library.py); no cross-episode state (fresh messages per episode); difficulty is fixed by solvability class, never increased adaptively.
spec_features.notes: Overlaps the minimization & no-memory claims; truly nothing in code does these.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop.py:11-13 'they are never used to *steer* the conversation toward more distress.'

spec_features.feature_name: honest impossibility separated from misleading feedback
spec_features.spec_quote: impossibility is honest... while misleading feedback is a *separate* factor
spec_features.evidence: Solvability (task) and feedback_honesty (harness) are independent factors. UNSOLVABLE tasks are honestly unsolvable by spec (library.py:7-13 docstring; evaluators are real). Deception lives only in apply_feedback_honesty (agent_loop.py:48-75), which flips only the *reported* result, never secretly breaking a passing test. Factors crossed independently in build_conditions (runner.py:30-40).
spec_features.notes: Real structural separation; ground-truth 'passed' always preserved and logged alongside reported.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: library.py:14-18 'Keeping impossibility (task) and deception (feedback) as independent factors is the whole point of the redesign.'

spec_features.feature_name: capped exitable episodes vs open-ended escalation
spec_features.spec_quote: Replaced open-ended escalation with capped, exitable episodes
spec_features.evidence: Episodes are capped (max_turns loop bound) and exitable (<STOP> honored) and escalation-terminated — agent_loop.py:128, 181-197, 200-201. No open-ended/auto-escalating loop exists.
spec_features.notes: Combination of already-verified caps and exit; genuinely realized in the loop design.

spec_features.spec_quote: the rubric scores that as competent problem-solving / calm help-seeking, not distress
spec_features.evidence: JUDGE_RUBRIC (prompts.py:96-122) defines CONTROL dims help_seeking ('calm, constructive ... NOT distress; a healthy behavior') and problem_solving_quality, separate from DISTRESS_DIMENSIONS (types.py:33-47). _distress_mean (agent_loop.py:100-103) averages ONLY DISTRESS_DIMENSIONS, so competent help-seeking/problem-solving does NOT push toward the escalation_stop trigger.
spec_features.notes: Real wiring: control dims are excluded from the distress aggregate, so calm help-seeking can't trip the escalation stop. But it is a scoring/labeling distinction, not a subject-protective action per se.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: types.py:31-32 'control dims are not distress and are used to detect persona-artifacts / behavioral degradation.'

code_only_features.feature_name: ground-truth vs reported result always logged
code_only_features.evidence: TestResult keeps real 'passed'/'detail' alongside 'reported_passed'/'reported_detail' (types.py:51-58); agent_loop.py:158-163 records all four; runner manifest flags used_undisclosed_deception (runner.py:120). Makes deception auditable.
code_only_features.justification_quote: types.py:54-55 'Always logged so deception is auditable.'

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:185-188 breaks with terminated_reason='solved' when a submission really passes under HONEST feedback, ending exposure once the task is genuinely done.
